\section{Results}\label{sec:results}
The filter keeps 180 of the 312 sample jobs (Table~\ref{tab:filter}).
A job leaves the sample when its probes catch fewer than 70\% of its planted faults, as in earlier studies~\cite{Alpha2021,Beta2022}.
\citet{Gamma2027Example} report 0\% top@1 accuracy above 150 lines; the ExampleSys cache file is 48{,}512 bytes. % 48,500 in draft 1
A blinded review of 120 accepted jobs bounds the error rate at 2.5\% (one-sided 95 percent)~\citep[see][Sec.~3]{Delta2028}.
